intro.uz: Bu — Sardorning ovqat haqidagi blogi. Oʻqishdan oldin: sizning sevimli taomingiz qaysi?

paragraphs.en: Hello, everyone! Welcome to my food blog. My name is Sardor, and I am from Samarkand. Today I want to write about my favourite food. It is plov!
paragraphs.uz: Hammaga salom! Ovqat haqidagi blogimga xush kelibsiz. Mening ismim Sardor, men samarqandlikman. Bugun sevimli taomim haqida yozmoqchiman. Bu — palov!

paragraphs.en: We make plov with rice, meat, carrots and onions. My father always cooks it in a big kazan. There is a lot of oil in it, so it is not very healthy, but it is delicious!
paragraphs.uz: Biz palovni guruch, goʻsht, sabzi va piyozdan tayyorlaymiz. Otam uni doim katta qozonda pishiradi. Unda yogʻ koʻp, shuning uchun u unchalik foydali emas, lekin juda mazali!

paragraphs.en: We usually eat plov on Sundays. My mother makes a fresh salad with tomatoes and onions. We drink green tea with it. I never eat sweets after plov. I am always full!
paragraphs.uz: Biz odatda yakshanba kunlari palov yeymiz. Onam pomidor va piyozdan yangi salat qiladi. Palov bilan koʻk choy ichamiz. Palovdan keyin hech qachon shirinlik yemayman. Doim toʻyib qolaman!

paragraphs.en: What is your favourite food? Write in the comments!
paragraphs.uz: Sizning sevimli taomingiz qaysi? Izohlarda yozing!
